reviewMethod.scope: 34 topics × 6 release locales (204 records): 34 German topics from independent full-read evidence plus 170 old-locale judgments retained through verified immutable lineage and an actual shared-data delta review.
reviewMethod.independence: Reviewer did not author or edit German content. Reviewer authored original Japanese translations; this report does not self-approve them. Existing Japanese prose is unchanged from 270f26a and retains the separate /root/de_full_author independent full-read and media-delta evidence. The present Japanese-locale judgment is only the new German-menu/shared-data delta.
method: Read all 29 German documentation bodies and two articles as German, plus all 210 UI and 11 framework messages and the complete author data patch, before consulting English for the proposed clarity fixes.
Independently reread the integrator changes to the genanki workflow sentence, Rust/Node numeric-zero wording, exact whitespace-key rule, internal-tools qualification and persistence-error wording.
Compare every one of the 33 production German files with the exact reviewed staging and delta hashes. All match; map the same 31 longforms to stable section contracts.

Read the final German-only vocabulary delta against concepts, compatibility, updates and the authoring guide; confirm ordinary German inflections/compound words and limit-oriented client-history terms without reading the frozen query set.

Reconstruct all 226 old-locale review dependencies from immutable 270f26a and recompute 170 signatures against the Japanese final-v2 snapshot and independent final report. Verify seven cited report/source hashes and all 38 retained minor spans.

Compare whole site-model syntax after removing only de properties; existing projections and implementation are identical. Read the unchanged LanguageSwitcher component and its new selected Deutsch entry. Old prompts, briefs, metadata, sidebar labels and vocabulary remain unchanged.
Recompute every current final-candidate signature and bind the language judgments to those 204 sourceHash/targetHash/technicalDependencyHash values.
reviewMethod.exclusions: No technical-axis approval, SDK execution, browser/layout acceptance, independent Pagefind ranking evaluation or deployment approval. Final post-build usage tasks remain separate.

closedFindings.quote: erzeugst v1 und vergleichst und bereitest anschließend v2 gegen das ursprüngliche v1-APKG vor. Erst danach veröffentlichst du sie.
closedFindings.issue: The coordinated verbs vergleichen and vorbereiten have different complements; the sentence attaches gegen/vor ambiguously and makes the reader reconstruct the workflow.
closedFindings.recommendation: erzeugst v1, vergleichst v2 mit dem ursprünglichen v1-APKG und bereitest v2 auf dieser Grundlage für die Veröffentlichung vor. Erst danach veröffentlichst du v2.

resolution.scope: Reread the complete affected German paragraph after the integrator correction.

closedFindings.quote: null ist ein tatsächliches Nullbudget / null bedeutet null, nicht unbegrenzt
closedFindings.issue: German null is a valid word for zero, but in a Node API paragraph it can be read as the JavaScript null value. The actual value is numeric 0.
closedFindings.recommendation: Node: `0` ist ein tatsächliches Nullbudget. Rust: `0` bedeutet ein Budget von null, nicht unbegrenzt.
